Maybe the title already sounds like I'm TA, but please hear me out. I (30F) have an older sister (40F). She has been emotionally abusive towards me my whole life. Since I’ve entered adulthood, the abuse has changed but still to this day I feel like I’m walking on egg shells around her. Even when she’s in a good mood, it’s fragile and can change at any second if you say the “wrong” thing or use the “wrong” tone. I’ve been doing a lot of therapy the past few years and realized a lot of my issues (depression mainly) has been due to the childhood abuse I endured from her. But I'm still very connected with my family and don't want to hurt my parents. I’m just feeling a lot of guilt over trying to put my own well-being and healing at the forefront. I’m open to your constructive judgments.
